Author: romaindolbeau
Content:
I'm trying to get decent performance out of a design, and the gap between the slow and fast corner is massive. But I don't really need the full quasi-military range of -40/125 and 4.5/5.5 ; I'm replicating a chip whose original specifications were for 0/70 and 4.75/5.25.
Is there any plan to characterize additional corners with reduced range, like 0/85 and 4.75/5.25 that would help with timings for devices intended for commercial rather than industrial/military use?

Author: chips4makers
Content:
A sidenote.
The voltage range for the corners includes both external voltage drop and on-chip voltage drop. I have seen total +/- 10% with dividing it equally over both e.g. 5% external and 5% on-chip. This matches to have 4.5/5.5 spec no-chip for external vdd spec of 4.75/5.25.
